title: Reuse After the Loop
goal: Double the numbers AND keep the originals — pick the iterator that doesn't eat its input.
hints: into_iter() consumes the Vec — the elements move out, and nums is gone.
iter() lends: the closure sees &i32, and multiplying a &i32 by 2 works just fine.
explanation: The three iterator families differ in what they take: into_iter() moves the collection (nums dies — E0382 at the second println), iter() borrows it (elements arrive as &i32, which arithmetic happily accepts), iter_mut() borrows mutably. Cloning first also 'works' — by paying for a full copy of the Vec. When you need the collection afterwards, iter() is the answer, not clone.
